Practised speed conversion from km/h to m/s.
Compared speed with velocity using displacement and direction.
Used a = (v − u)/t, including negative acceleration.
Solved acceleration examples, including braking and uniform acceleration.

end.parentNote: Diya practised converting speed units and applying the acceleration formula, including braking as negative acceleration. They correctly solved several acceleration examples and later identified that braking is also acceleration; this corrected the earlier mix-up that acceleration only means speeding up. Speed versus velocity and displacement-based examples need another short practice round. At home, draw a simple number line or motion diagram and ask Diya to label direction, displacement, velocity, and acceleration.
